scope: Conservative model labels; original source labels and response values preserved. Every unlisted label maps to itself. Unspecified isomers, position-specific cis labels, total/free/ester pools and mixtures stay distinct.

beta_carotene_and_lycopene.locator: primary article explicitly equates all-trans-beta-carotene (all-E-betaC) and all-trans-lycopene (all-E-L)

lutein_E.locator: analytical method distinguishes E/Z-lutein and lutein esters; all-E analytical standards

echinenone_typo.locator: Tables 1 and 2 identify all-E-echinenone; prose spelling equinenone

unmerged_pool_example.reason: 10.3390/antiox8080291 explicitly includes observed cis isomers; 10.1021/jf071687a does not establish equivalent cis coverage
